source_claim: The public opportunity map cites MAP-Elites as a starting point for quality-diversity archives, not as evidence of superiority over random_weighted.
hypothesis: Within one fixed era/config and matched paired-run seed set, allocating proposals to the least-evaluated observable valid rotation-subfamily × loaded-feature cells will find more qualifying signals in under-covered cells at the same completed-evaluation count than uniform random_weighted, while keeping overall qualifying yield within a preregistered non-inferiority margin. Failure to increase observed valid-cell coverage, or a yield loss beyond that margin, rejects the direction; if cell eligibility or attribution cannot be observed, no feature × rotation claim is made.
evidence_gaps: The map says MAP-Elites is a starting point and recommends reopening the source before relying on its mechanism; the original paper was not reopened in this offline exercise, so its mechanism remains unverified here.
